generate_all_trace_html: generate HTML trace viewer pages for all scenarios in a Gaia2 benchmark run output directory
generate_runs_index_dashboard: generate a landing page listing all runs and experiments in a Gaia2 traces root directory
generate_experiment_dashboard: generate an experiment dashboard HTML page comparing multiple pass@N runs with split breakdown and pass@N stats
generate_split_dashboard: generate per-split dashboard HTML pages showing scenario-level comparison matrix across multiple runs
generate_waiting_page: generate a placeholder index.html auto-refreshing page for a Gaia2 run that has not yet produced scenario results
